meta.author: claude
meta.description: Road piece (dirt), level 1 of 3: shell and fittings (what soldiers build first). A slab-height road (half a block over the grass, never a full block): cobblestone slab curbs and set stones with earth between them; the earth (coarse dirt, gravel, a dirt path line) is a ground_replace decoration that swaps the top ground block, so the Studio shows grass there. Level 2 fills the paving with mossy cobblestone, stone, andesite, mud brick and tuff slabs and adds moss and pebbles; level 3 wildflowers, grass and a milestone. Tiles end to end. Decoration step adds: ground_replace.
meta.changes: Slab height now (half a block, not a full block above the grass): a fixed pattern of cobblestone, mossy, stone, andesite, mud brick and tuff slabs with earth stretches recorded for the decoration step, plus poppies, twigs, moss, pebbles and a lamp post along the edges.
